definition: Consistent (a,b) means a = not b and b = a and b, over Bool. Sensitive records that negation differs on false/true and conjunction differs when either argument varies with the other fixed true. Controls asserts sensitivity, consistency of (true,false), and that every consistent pair equals that witness.
